scientific_integrity: Constructive realization theorem proved using binomial local limits and disjoint-subtree independence; finite computations are supplemental and not infinite proofs.
scientific_limitations: Only complete uniformly n-ary rooted trees of height three with independent fair propositional labels are covered.
The modulus and rational target profile are fixed as the branching factor grows.
No classification, decidability theorem or modal-depth minimality for general counting-modal formulas is claimed.
Priority remains subject to older uninspected specialized literature.
title: Rational periodic limits in three-layer counting modal logic
